$comment: Declared invariants for world state, saves and replays (SPEC_STATE_SAVES_REPLAYS section 4). Schema-level cases are EXECUTABLE via conformance/schema-assertions.json (state/fixtures). The invariants below are already PROVEN on the phase-1 spike kernel (spike/wasm-kernel/receipt.json: continuity and instance isolation) and become executable on the real kernel.

vectors.note: N ticks ≡ K ticks + save + restore + (N−K) ticks by stateHash; proven on the spike kernel at N=10000, K=5000
two instances with one composition and one journal never diverge, even interleaved with a third instance; proven on the spike kernel
composition + journal reproduces every recorded checkpoint
a save at section version v migrated to v+1 and continued matches a fresh run at v+1 from the same tick
every stateArea an active intrinsic writes maps to exactly one save section; space → space-deltas
